title: B2B Growth Marketing Manager (Paid Media & HubSpot)
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high‑quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

About the Role

  • We are looking for a growth‑focused B2B marketer with a strong foundation in paid media and marketing automation. You will be responsible for driving qualified leads to our nearshore staffing solutions using a mix of paid strategies and sophisticated HubSpot automation.
  • You will not just be "buying media", you will be owning the engine that connects innovative US companies with world‑class engineering talent in Latin America. You are well‑versed in Google Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and HubSpot, and you understand the nuances of marketing complex B2B services to technical decision‑makers.
  • Our ideal candidate thrives on data and uses it to craft high‑performing B2B campaigns. You understand that selling a partnership is different from selling a product, it requires trust, authority, and multiple touch points. You are organized, detail‑oriented, and possess a "White Belt Mentality", always eager to learn and improve. Above all, you are a "Human" first, bringing a positive, engaged personality that strengthens our remote, transparency‑first culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • B2B Media Planning & Strategy:
  • HubSpot Ownership: Serve as the internal subject matter expert for HubSpot. You will not just use it, but optimize it—building workflows, lead scoring models, and attribution reports that connect ad spend to closed client deals.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive B2B media plans that target decision‑makers at startups and enterprise companies who need to scale their engineering teams.
  • Market Research: Conduct deep analysis to identify where our target audience (technical leaders) consumes content and how best to reach them.
  • Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging B2B trends, AI integrations in marketing, and new channels for reaching technical talent buyers.
  • Sales Enablement: Advise the New Business and Account teams on recommended budgets and strategies to support their pipeline goals.
  • Campaign Execution & Management:
  • Multi‑Channel Execution: Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns with a heavy focus on LinkedIn Ads (Account‑Based Marketing) and Google Ads (High‑intent search).
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors or agencies to ensure day‑to‑day execution aligns with our strategic vision.
  • Full‑Funnel Analytics: Track B2B KPIs beyond just "clicks"—focusing on MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads), SQLs (Sales Qualified Leads), Cost Per Discovery Call, and Pipeline Velocity.
  • Optimization: Analyze campaign data to identify areas for improvement, such as refining audience segments (e.g., targeting specific tech stacks like React or Python users) to improve lead quality.
  • Budget & ROI Management:
  • Budget Pacing: Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize Client Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Forecasting: Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing, ensuring campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Efficiency: Identify opportunities for cost‑saving without compromising the quality of inbound leads.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B performance marketing or media buying. Experience specifically in the Staffing, Recruiting, or SaaS sectors is a massive plus.
  • HubSpot Proficiency is Required: Must have deep experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub (workflows, landing pages, list segmentation) and CRM integration. HubSpot certifications are highly preferred.
  • Paid Media Expert: Strong experience in paid platforms, specifically LinkedIn Campaign Manager (for B2B targeting) and Google Ads.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics 4, HubSpot Reports, LinkedIn Insights Tag).
  • Strong Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex marketing data to non‑marketing stakeholders.
  • Self‑Motivated: Able to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining close collaboration with the team.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms)
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

title: Video Strategist
description:
As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Note: This is a contract-to-hire position

MUST HAVE:

  • Demonstrated experience driving video performance, engagement, and watch time, ideally in a revenue-focused environment
  • Strong understanding of video syndication platforms (MSN preferred) and how they reward engagement
  • Hands-on experience with scriptwriting, editing feedback, and video optimization
  • Comfort managing freelancers, assigning work, and overseeing quality and deadlines
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects at once
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Willingness to experiment, test, and iterate quickly
  • Openness to incorporating AI tools into scripting, ideation, and workflow optimization

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years in video strategy, video production, or performance-driven video roles within digital media, performance marketing, or content monetization. Personal finance experience or familiarity strongly preferred.

YOUR ROLE

You’ll own the strategy, planning, and performance of FinanceBuzz’s video content, with a primary focus on syndication platforms (especially MSN) where revenue is driven by consumed seconds of video. Secondarily, you’ll support video publishing and optimization for YouTube and social platforms.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll be directly involved in topic selection, scripting, editing feedback, thumbnail and on-screen graphic optimization, and performance analysis. Your goal is simple but ambitious: scale video revenue significantly over time while maintaining high-quality, trustworthy personal finance content.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching, comfort working with performance data, and the ability to manage multiple contributors and workflows at once. You should be equally comfortable zooming out to plan a content roadmap and zooming in to rewrite a script or leave frame-by-frame feedback.

This role is contract-to-hire and will play a key role in growing video from its current state (~$15K/month) into a $500K+ annual revenue stream.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Selecting video topics that consistently maximize viewer engagement, watch time, and revenue
  • Optimizing scripts to increase retention, clarity, and completion rates
  • Improving thumbnail and on-screen graphic performance through testing and iteration
  • Building and maintaining an efficient, scalable video workflow
  • Managing freelancers effectively: assigning work, giving clear feedback, and coordinating payments and budgets
  • Maintaining high quality and brand consistency across all video content
  • Monitoring video performance metrics and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Growing video revenue from its current level toward a $500K+ annual run rate
  • Establishing FinanceBuzz as a trusted and engaging personal finance video brand

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the video content strategy for syndication platforms, with a primary focus on MSN
  • Plan and maintain the video content calendar
  • Write, edit, and optimize video scripts
  • Provide detailed feedback to video editors and designers
  • Optimize thumbnails, titles, and on-screen graphics for engagement
  • Oversee video production workflows for speed, quality, and consistency
  • Manage freelance contributors and coordinate with internal stakeholders on budgets and payments
  • Conduct quality control on all video outputs
  • Track and report on video performance metrics and revenue

COMPETENCIES

  • Performance-Driven: Obsessed with engagement, watch time, and revenue outcomes
  • Detail-Oriented: Catches issues before they go live and pushes for constant improvement
  • Strategic & Tactical: Thinks big-picture while staying deeply involved in execution
  • Ownership Mentality: Treats the video business as their own and takes responsibility for results
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-changing environment and adjusts strategy based on performance data
  • Collaborative: Works closely with editorial, design, and operations partners
  • Coachability: Welcomes feedback and actively seeks ways to improve systems and output

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos.   • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;

We're looking for a Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst to guide research-driven decision-making for enterprise marketing website projects. You'll also lead client conversations and present UX rationale with confidence and clarity. This is a freelance contract position with consistent, ongoing project work.

    • Analyze user behavior, testing outputs, and analytics data (GA, Hotjar, Helio, etc.)
    • Identify friction points and conversion blockers across user journeys
    • Conduct competitive and comparative audits to inform structure and content direction
    • Synthesize insights into clear, prioritized, actionable UX recommendations
  • Information Architecture & Content Strategy
    • Audit existing website structures and perform detailed site map analysis
    • Develop and present site map recommendations that improve clarity, SEO alignment, and user flow
    • Create navigation models, content hierarchies, and IA documentation
    • Map user journeys and define key conversion paths
    • Build content frameworks and messaging priorities for enterprise web builds
    • Evaluate existing content for gaps, redundancy, clarity, and strategic alignment
  • Wireframing & Concepting
    • Translate IA and strategy decisions into low-fidelity wireframes
    • Produce clear UX documentation (flows, diagrams, wireframes, rationale)
    • Collaborate closely with designers to ensure strategic alignment through execution
  • Client Leadership
    • Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and UX debriefs
    • Present research findings and guide stakeholders toward best-practice decisions
    • Communicate fluently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing
    • Build trust through structured thinking, preparedness, and strong strategic reasoning

Requirements

  • 5–6+ years of experience in UX research, UX strategy, IA, or content design for websites
  • Deep understanding of enterprise marketing sites (not product UX)

This is not a product UX role — it's a strategic position focused on user insight, information architecture, content strategy, and low-fidelity wireframing for B2B website design specifically.

You will run discovery activities, analyze user behavior, shape content and navigation strategy, and translate research into clear wireframes and recommendations. You'll also lead client conversations and present UX rationale with confidence and clarity. This is a freelance contract position with consistent, ongoing project work.

  • Information Architecture & Content Strategy
    • Audit existing website structures and perform detailed site map analysis

    • Map user journeys and define key conversion paths

  • Wireframing & Concepting
    • Translate IA and strategy decisions into low-fidelity wireframes
    • Produce clear UX documentation (flows, diagrams, wireframes, rationale)
    • Collaborate closely with designers to ensure strategic alignment through execution
  • Client Leadership
    • Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and UX debriefs
    • Present research findings and guide stakeholders toward best-practice decisions
    • Communicate fluently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing
    • Build trust through structured thinking, preparedness, and strong strategic reasoning

Requirements

  • 5–6+ years of experience in UX research, UX strategy, IA, or content design for websites
  • Deep understanding of enterprise marketing sites (not product UX)
  • Proven ability to plan, execute, and analyze UX research
  • Strong command of information architecture and content strategy
  • Ability to design clear, low-fi wireframes that translate strategy into structure
  • Excellent English communication skills and confidence leading client conversations

Nice to Have

Company Introduction

From its global hub in Dubai, Emirates is the award‑winning airline that serves customers on six continents, providing high quality air transport services that facilitate tourism and trade. The airline has earned customer recognition for its industry‑leading services on the ground and in the sky, delivered by a passionate workforce representing over 160 nations. Emirates operates the world’s largest fleet of wide‑body Boeing 777 and Airbus A380 aircraft, offering spacious cabins and iconic inflight features such as its A380 Shower Spa and Onboard Lounge, and its ICE inflight entertainment system available in all seats across its fleet, offering up to 6,500 channels of on‑demand, multi‑language content.

Be part of a new pilot era with Emirates

Exciting changes are on the horizon at Emirates for our next generation of pilots

We’re looking for motivated pilots to join the Emirates flight deck in an exciting time of opportunity and growth. We’ve got big and ambitious plans for the future, and we want the very best pilots at the helm of our modern fleet of aircraft.

With enhanced benefits and improved eligibility criteria, there’s never been a better time to become an Emirates pilot.

Along with growing your career with the world’s largest international airline, there’s much more to being an Emirates pilot. You’ll enjoy a generous tax‑free salary, rent‑free accommodation, Provident Fund contributions, education allowances, excellent medical and dental cover, chauffeur‑driven transport to work and fantastic travel benefits for you and your family.

So, if you’re looking for a game‑changing career opportunity, we want to meet you.

Description of the Position

Accelerated Command - This is a unique opportunity for you to join as a Boeing or Airbus First Officer on an enhanced salary package with an accelerated command upgrade scenario. Assuming you meet the standards and display the required level of performance, you will then be eligible for accelerated command via an assessment process and an upgrade course.

What the Company offers

  • Health Insurance

  • Discounts across leisure and retail outlets
  • Life Insurance
  • Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Concessional staff travel airline tickets

Minimum Salary

Minimum basic salary : AED 31,640 (~USD 8,621) not inclusive of flying pay

Maximum Salary

Dependant on position held

Minimum Required Experience

To join our Accelerated Command program, you will need the following experience :

  • Minimum of 5000 hours total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single / multi‑engine piston aircraft)
  • Minimum of 2000 hours command time on fixed wing, multi‑crew commercial jet aircraft with MTOW > 50 tonnes
  • You must currently be flying as captain and have a minimum of 1000 hours PIC on the either Boeing or Airbus
  • Minimum 150 hours in past 12 months on type

  • ICAO English Level 5 or above

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.

A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa de Customer Success que queira ir além do atendimento e atue como uma verdadeira parceira estratégica dos nossos clientes. Alguém que construa relações de confiança, entenda profundamente os desafios e objetivos de cada cliente e os ajude a transformar nossas soluções em resultados concretos e duradouros. Essa pessoa será protagonista da jornada do cliente, combinando empatia, visão analítica e mentalidade orientada a valor para identificar oportunidades, antecipar necessidades e impulsionar o sucesso de cada conta. Aqui, Customer Success é sobre impacto real na jornada de crédito, recebimento e cobrança no agro, reflexo de crescimento conjunto e experiências memoráveis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na gestão da carteira de clientes, assegurando engajamento, satisfação e sucesso na utilização dos serviços / produtos;
  • Realizar reuniões de onboarding, acompanhamento e alinhamentos periódicos (QBR, NPS, etc.);
  • Ser a voz do cliente internamente, identificando pontos de melhoria e repassando feedbacks para times internos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, expansão de receita e saúde da conta;
  • Antecipar riscos e agir proativamente para garantir renovação dos contratos;
  • Construir relacionamento consultivo, identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell;
  • Apoiar o cliente no planejamento e execução das melhores práticas de uso da plataforma / serviço;
  • Registrar informações e interações em sistemas internos (CRM).

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Suporte ao Cliente, Atendimento ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura consultiva;
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de dados e tomada de decisões;
  • Organização, autonomia e habilidade para gerir múltiplas contas simultaneamente;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM (ex : HubSpot, RD Station, etc.);
  • Perfil orientado a resultados e solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto e bases fundiárias, com capacidade de interpretar mapas, croquis e informações georreferenciadas;
  • Experiência prévia nas áreas de crédito e / ou cobrança, compreendendo fluxos operacionais, análise de risco e acompanhamento de carteiras;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint, com facilidade para manipulação de dados, geração de relatórios e construção de apresentações
  • Perfil proativo e orientado a desafios, capaz de lidar bem com demandas dinâmicas, encontrar soluções práticas e transformar obstáculos em oportunidades.

Diferenciais

title: Product Owner
description:
Procuramos um profissional talentoso e experiente para atuar como PMO (Project Management Officer) ou PO (Project Owner) em um projeto estratégico de Data Visualization de alta complexidade para nosso cliente. O projeto envolve a transformação de grandes volumes de dados em insights acionáveis através de dashboards e relatórios. O candidato deve ser fluente em inglês para gerenciar e colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, stakeholders e parceiros em nível global.

Responsabilidades Principais

Gestão de Projeto / Produto :

  • PMO Foco: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo do projeto, incluindo escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos e qualidade, garantindo que os objetivos estratégicos sejam alcançados dentro do prazo.
  • PO Foco: Definir, priorizar e manter o Product Backlog do projeto de DataViz, traduzindo as necessidades dos stakeholders e do cliente em histórias de usuário claras e critérios de aceitação.
  • Comunicação Global: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, facilitando a comunicação clara e eficaz entre o cliente, stakeholders executivos e os times técnicos distribuídos globalmente.
  • Análise e Requisitos de Dados: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com analistas de dados e designers para refinar os requisitos de visualização, garantindo que os dashboards atendam às necessidades de informação e apresentem a narrativa correta.
  • Governança: Estabelecer e manter padrões, processos e métricas de desempenho (KPIs) para o projeto, garantindo a transparência e o alinhamento estratégico.
  • Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar proativamente riscos e impedimentos, desenvolvendo planos de mitigação e escalando problemas quando necessário.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência Comprovada: experiência atuando como PMO, Gerente de Projetos ou Product Owner em projetos de alta complexidade e grande escala.
  • Proficiência em Inglês: Fluência obrigatória (escrita e conversação) para comunicação diária com times e stakeholders internacionais.
  • Metodologias: Forte conhecimento e experiência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e / ou tradicionais (PMBOK).
  • Data & DataViz: Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de Data Visualization, Business Intelligence (BI) e Storytelling com dados. Capacidade de entender a estrutura de dados e como ela suporta a visualização final.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos, com experiência em interagir em nível executivo.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis (Um Diferencial)

  • Ferramentas de DataViz: Experiência prática com ferramentas líderes de mercado como Tableau, Power BI ou Looker Studio (Google Data Studio).
  • Certificações: Certificações relevantes (e.g., PMP, PSM / CSM, SAFe).

title: Senior Product Designer (Ux / Ui)
description:
About Uitify

Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early‑stage SaaS startups based in the United States.

We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user‑centric digital experiences.

With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast‑growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer.

This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast‑paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands‑on product thinker with a deep understanding of user‑centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise‑grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high‑fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user‑centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years of experience as a Product Designer

  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data‑heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role‑based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US‑based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, you will work on high‑impact projects for fast‑growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.

You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting‑edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your resume and portfolio.

…keep reading. You might be exactly who we’ve been waiting for.

We’re hiring a Google + Microsoft Ads Manager to drive real outcomes for our clients— leads, sales, booked jobs, and revenue . And not just as an operator : in 2026 , this person will help build and lead a small paid search team , meaning you’ll need to know how to train, delegate, and scale people —not just campaigns.

Pay is extremely competitive because we’re not looking for average. We’re looking for a weapon. A kind one. But still a weapon.

What you’ll be doing (aka how you’ll earn your BLG cape)

  • Run paid search like a performance business

    • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube where relevant)
    • Microsoft Ads (Search + Audience Network when it makes sense)
    • Own performance outcomes : ROAS, CPL, CAC, MQL→SQL quality, booked calls, revenue

Be the “funnel detective”

  • Audit landing pages, lead flow, tracking, and conversion paths
  • Use GA4, GTM, call tracking, CRM data, heatmaps, and dashboards to find :
  • leaks
  • drop-offs
  • fake conversions
  • and “why is this lead trash?” moments

Make AI + automation part of the operating system

You don’t need to be a developer, but you do need to already speak the language :

  • Use (and improve) automation systems with tools like :
  • Make.com, Zapier, GoHighLevel, ChatGPT
  • Automate :
  • reporting
  • pacing alerts
  • QA checks
  • creative / copy iteration
  • internal handoffs
  • So you spend time optimizing , not playing spreadsheet whack-a-mole.

Build a team in 2026

  • Document processes and turn wins into repeatable playbooks
  • Help hire + train junior buyers / assistants
  • Lead through delegation, coaching, and accountability
  • (If “leadership” to you means “I’ll just do it myself,” we’ll lovingly escort you back to the internet.)

You’re a great fit if…

You’re a proven platform expert

  • You have real experience managing Google + Microsoft Ads
  • You understand :
  • match type strategy
  • query sculpting
  • negative keyword hygiene
  • conversion tracking realities (not fairy tales)
  • budget allocation based on marginal returns
  • You can explain why something worked, not just that it worked.

You’re built like a scientist, not a gambler

  • You test, iterate, and measure like your rent depends on it
  • You make decisions using :
  • data
  • business context
  • and common sense (rare, but we still believe)

You embrace AI & automation like it’s your unfair advantage

  • You actively use AI tools to speed up :
  • ad copy
  • landing page iteration ideas
  • keyword research
  • script drafting
  • analysis and reporting narratives
  • You’re always looking for “how do we do this faster without getting dumber?”

You live our Core Values (without being weird about it)

Excellence in All We Do

You don’t ship sloppy work and call it “version one.”

Commitment & Accountability

You own outcomes, not excuses.

Mutually Beneficial Relationships

You want clients to win and you want the team to win—no ego, no sabotage, no drama.

Learning & Development

You’re not “already good.” You’re getting better constantly.

What success looks like here

  • ROAS increases, CPL / CAC drops, lead quality improves
  • Clients renew because results are undeniable
  • Tracking is clean, reporting is useful, and decisions are faster
  • Automations reduce busy work and your time goes into strategy
  • By 2026, you’re helping lead paid search—not just running it

About BestLyfe Group (BLG)

We’re a no-BS, high-output growth partner for small businesses who want real results—not “marketing activity.”

We blend strategy, paid acquisition, conversion, automation, and leadership to drive measurable outcomes. We move fast, we tell the truth, and we hold a high bar.

If you’re looking for comfort, predictability, and low standards—this will feel like CrossFit.

If you’re looking to level up, build a career moat, and be part of a team that actually executes—welcome home.

Perks & Culture

  • 100% remote
  • Access to best-in-class tools (AI, automation, reporting, creative systems)
  • Fast-paced environment with direct feedback and high trust
  • Clear path into leadership as we scale in 2026
  • A team that values ownership, humor, transparency, and performance

Ready to apply?

Apply on LinkedIn and then email me : with :

  • 2. A quick example of :
  • ad copy, or
  • account audit insight, or
  • funnel / landing page recommendations you’ve made
  • 3. A short note answering :
  • Why BLG?
  • How do you see yourself growing into leadership by 2026?
  • 4. Your CV + LinkedIn profile

What happens after you apply (so there are no surprises)

If we like what we see, we’ll send you a short video screener.

No trick questions. No corporate nonsense.

Just a chance for us to see how you think, communicate, and show up—because culture, clarity, and ownership matter here.

If the video feels aligned, we’ll move forward to a proper interview.

If not, no harm, no ghosting, no weird energy.

Simple. Human. Efficient. Very BLG.

We’re building something serious.

If you’re ready to help businesses win and become a sharper, more valuable operator and leader…

Let’s go.

CEO, BestLyfe Group

Aqui, educamos diversos cidadãos por meio de uma educação academicamente rigorosa, desafiadora e global. Reconhecemos que as crianças e adolescentes precisam aprender a assumir riscos e serem arquitetos de suas próprias jornadas.

Para isso, contamos com uma equipe cosmopolita, engajada, muito qualificada e apaixonada por educação !

No momento, estamos procurando educadores altamente qualificados, bilíngues, de preferência com experiência em escolas bilíngues, ou escolas com programas semelhantes aos nossos.

Se você é flexível, inovador, proativo, comprometido com o trabalho em equipe e se adapta facilmente às mudanças, você é o tipo de professor que estamos procurando.

Main responsibilities

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Bilingual College and Career Counselor fluent in Portuguese and English to join our team. The successful candidate will provide guidance and support to students as they navigate their post-high school education and career goals. As a Bilingual College and Career Counselor, you will work collaboratively with students, families, and educators to provide resources and information that will help them make informed decisions about their future. This is a highly rewarding role that offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of students.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide individual and group counseling to students on college and career planning, including academic planning, career exploration, and the college selection and application process.
  • Develop and implement college and career readiness programs and workshops for students and families.
  • Assist students in identifying their strengths, interests, and goals to help them make informed decisions about their future.
  • Stay up-to-date on trends and developments in college admissions, financial aid, and career opportunities and share this information with students and families.
  • Collaborate with educators, administrators, and community organizations to develop and implement college and career readiness initiatives and programs.
  • Serve as a liaison between the school and post-secondary institutions, employers, and other community partners to promote opportunities for students.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of student progress and provide reports to administrators as needed.
  • Attend professional development opportunities and conferences to stay informed about best practices in college and career counseling.
  • Participate in school events and initiatives to promote a college and career culture.

Requirements and skills

  • Degree in education or related fields.
  • Experience in college and career counseling or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of college admissions, financial aid, and career exploration resources.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively work with students, families, and educators.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Commitment to providing equitable access to college and career opportunities for all students.
  • Familiarity with college and career readiness software and tools is preferred.
  • If you are passionate about helping students achieve their goals and are committed to providing them with the resources and support they need to succeed, we encourage you to apply for this position.

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.

title: Executivo de Vendas Sr.
description:
Nosso objetivo é oferecer um Melhor Cuidado para um Mundo Melhor e isso requer pessoas e equipes que se preocupam em fazer a diferença todos os dias. Aqui, você irá contribuir com a sua experiência profissional, talento e motivação para continuar a levar nossas marcas icônicas e inovadoras para a vida de milhões de pessoas. Nessa função, você vai nos ajudar a impactar a vida de milhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Tudo isso começa com VOCÊ!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas Estratégico(a), com forte capacidade analítica, pensamento estratégico e perfil orientado a resultados, para atuar no atendimento indireto Farma. Nesse papel de Executivo de Vendas em Salvador/BA , você irá:

  • Promover o crescimento sustentável das vendas por meio de ações de sell in e suporte ao sell out, ampliando o mix de produtos e fortalecendo a execução nos pontos de venda.
  • Realizar visitas regulares aos distribuidores e clientes, acompanhando os vendedores em campo, conduzindo treinamentos e garantindo a correta aplicação das estratégias comerciais.
  • Liderar a construção e acompanhamento de JBP (Joint Business Plan) com os principais parceiros, alinhando metas, investimentos e planos de ação.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, estoques, preços praticados e rupturas, utilizando ferramentas analíticas para gerar insights e propor ações corretivas.
  • Atuar como elo entre os distribuidores e áreas internas (marketing, logística, finanças), assegurando fluidez operacional, alinhamento estratégico e excelência na execução.

Você já conhece nossas marcas Huggies®, Intimus®, Poise®, Plenitud® e os produtos da Kimberly-Clark não existiriam sem profissionais talentosos como você. Aqui, você fará parte de uma equipe comprometida em impulsionar a inovação, o crescimento e o impacto de nossas atividades. Temos mais de 150 anos de liderança de mercado e estamos sempre em busca de novas e melhores formas de desempenho – portanto, esse é o seu momento de aproveitar nossas oportunidades em aberto. Esperamos por você na Kimberly-Clark.

Somos inspirados por um propósito e guiados pelo desempenho.

Somos uma empresa comprometida com a inclusão, a equidade e a diversidade, para impulsionar nossos resultados de negócio e impactar positivamente a vida de pessoas colaboradoras, consumidoras, fornecedoras e comunidades. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas visando promover uma cultura inclusiva, ou seja, respeitamos e abraçamos a diversidade de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade e deficiência. Você atua no mais alto nível possível e aprecia uma cultura de desempenho alimentada por um cuidado autêntico com as pessoas ao seu redor, desejando fazer parte de uma empresa ativamente dedicada à sustentabilidade, inclusão, bem-estar e desenvolvimento de carreira. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você experimentará o “Flex That Works”: modelo de trabalho flexível e se concentrará em conquistar os consumidores e o mercado, ao mesmo tempo que colocará a segurança, o respeito mútuo e o cuidado no centro.

Bonus Points

Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote‑first team with a strong performance culture

Employment Details

This opportunity is offered as a full‑time independent contractor role.

Please Don't Apply If

You prefer a low‑pressure, low‑output environment

You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross‑functional teams

You don't meet the minimum customer success experience

No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Onboarding Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management

Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.

Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.

Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.

Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue

Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.

Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.

Negotiate and close deals effectively.

Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.

Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.

Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills

Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.

Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.

Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.

Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Strong negotiation and closing skills.

Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.

Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers

A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.

A flexible vacation / leave plan that fits your needs.

Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.

An opportunity for professional growth and development.

A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Data Product Owner
description:
Buscamos um Product Owner apaixonado por dados e com visão de produto para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas inovadoras no setor de saúde.

Você será responsável por traduzir necessidades complexas de negócio em produtos de dados que empoderam decisões críticas, melhoram resultados clínicos e otimizam operações hospitalares. Esta não é uma posição tradicional de PO.

Você trabalhará na interseção entre dados, tecnologia e saúde, definindo roadmaps de produtos analíticos, dashboards inteligentes, APIs de dados e data products que realmente transformam a forma como hospitais e sistemas de saúde operam.

Se você tem paixão por dados, entende o contexto de saúde e sabe transformar complexidade técnica em valor para usuários, esta vaga é para você.

O que você vai fazer

Estratégia de Produto

  • Definir visão e roadmap de produtos de dados para o setor de saúde
  • Identificar oportunidades de novos produtos analíticos baseados em necessidades do mercado
  • Priorizar features e iniciativas com base em valor, esforço e impacto
  • Estabelecer métricas de sucesso e KPIs para produtos de dados
  • Criar business cases para novos produtos e funcionalidades
  • Acompanhar tendências em health tech, data products e analytics
  • Desejável experiência no seguimento de saúde

Gestão de Stakeholders

  • Conduzir discovery com médicos, gestores hospitalares e equipes clínicas
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos de dados
  • Apresentar demos e resultados para C-level e stakeholders
  • Gerenciar expectativas e comunicar progresso transparentemente
  • Facilitar alinhamentos entre áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Construir relacionamento de confiança com clientes internos e externos

Gestão do Backlog

  • Criar e refinar user stories com critérios de aceite claros
  • Priorizar backlog usando frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Value vs Effort)
  • Trabalhar próximo ao Tech Lead para viabilidade técnica
  • Definir MVPs e estratégias de entrega incremental
  • Garantir qualidade e completude das entregas
  • Documentar requisitos funcionais e casos de uso

Rituais Ágeis e Entregas

  • Facilitar sprint planning, reviews e retrospectivas
  • Validar entregas em homologação antes de produção
  • Priorizar bugs e débito técnico junto ao time
  • Tomar decisões rápidas para desbloquear o squadGarantir alinhamento contínuo entre time e objetivos
  • Celebrar conquistas e aprender com desafios

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação.

Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais : Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores.

Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas.

Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos.

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam : Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

Arquitetar e implementar soluções de dados end-to-end, incluindo pipelines, integrações e camadas de armazenamento em Azure e Microsoft Fabric.

Garantir governança, segurança e conformidade dos dados, definindo padrões, metadados e controles de acesso.

Otimizar performance, escalabilidade e custos da arquitetura de dados corporativa.

Colaborar com áreas de negócio e times técnicos, liderando tecnicamente e orientando profissionais mais juniores.

Impulsionar inovação tecnológica, avaliando e adoptando soluções modernas como IA aplicada a analytics e arquiteturas lakehouse.

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação (Será testado)
  • Microsoft Fabric e OneLake
  • Microsoft Data Services (Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake e / ou SQL Database)
  • Python, SQL e ETL
  • PowerBI

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A / B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A / B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.

We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A / B testing app to earn that distinction.

What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.

As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.

Here's what makes this role unique : We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A / B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS. Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.

The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of "brand recognizes brand" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.

What You’ll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before / after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency

Brand & Sales Materials

  • Build feature landing page designs that follow "show-don't-tell" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency

You’ll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

You'll thrive if you :

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally

Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design

Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)

What We Offer

Salary : $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits : Flexible remote work

Generous time off policy

Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand

Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out

Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered :

When submitting you'll be asked to include :

Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)

A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences) : Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.

We're excited to meet you!

title: Vendedor De Serviços De Saúde De Forma E-Commerce
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O(a) Vendedor(a) é o profissional responsável por conduzir o cliente (familiar ou paciente) desde a captação do lead online (e-commerce, formulários, redes sociais) até o fechamento do contrato de serviço de Home Care. Ele(a) atua como consultor especializado, diagnosticando as necessidades clínicas e logísticas do cliente, personalizando o plano de cuidados e apresentando a proposta comercial, garantindo uma experiência de compra baseada em confiança, agilidade e humanização. Como ter sucesso no cargo, o sucesso é medido não apenas pela taxa de fechamento de vendas, mas também pela qualidade do match entre o serviço vendido e a real necessidade do paciente.

O(a) Vendedor(a) será bem-sucedido(a) quando:

  • Diagnostica corretamente: Utiliza o conhecimento básico de saúde para entender a complexidade do paciente e encaminha o lead qualificado (tamanho do turno, tipo de profissional) para o Enfermeiro Supervisor.
  • Demonstra Empatia Digital: Constrói uma relação de confiança rapidamente, muitas vezes por meio de canais digitais (WhatsApp, e-mail), mediando a ansiedade e as dúvidas do familiar.>
  • Converte Leads de Alto Valor: Fecha contratos de planos de longo prazo ou de alta complexidade, utilizando os diferenciais da empresa (ex: visita médica semanal, jornada 6h) como justificativa de preço.
  • Encaixe na Organização Geral: O(a) Vendedor(a) é a porta de entrada da receita e o primeiro contato humano com a empresa. Ele(a) transforma o interesse digital em compromisso contratual.
  • Coordenação direta com Marketing Digital e Enfermagem/Clínico para validar a viabilidade clínica antes da formalização do contrato.

Responsabilidades e Funções (Dia a Dia)

  • Gestão e Qualificação de Leads Digitais
    • Atendimento Multicanal: Responder de forma rápida e profissional a leads gerados via formulários online, WhatsApp Business e redes sociais, mantendo o tempo de resposta (SLA) baixo.
    • Qualificação Inicial: Realizar entrevistas preliminares com o familiar/cliente para entender a necessidade (diagnóstico, grau de dependência, localidade) e classificar o lead no CRM (Pipedrive, etc.).
    • Gestão do CRM: Manter o funil de vendas atualizado, registrando todas as interações, documentação e status da negociação.
  • Consultoria e Elaboração de Propostas
    • Diagnóstico de Necessidade: Atuar como consultor(a), ajudando o cliente a definir o melhor plano de cuidados (ex: Cuidador vs. Técnico de Enfermagem, escala 6h vs. 12h), com base nas informações clínicas fornecidas.
    • Elaboração Personalizada de Propostas: Montar propostas comerciais transparentes, detalhando os serviços incluídos, os diferenciais (seus serviços premium) e as cláusulas contratuais relevantes.
    • Negociação e Fechamento: Negociar valores, formas de pagamento e alinhar expectativas sobre a prestação do serviço até a assinatura do contrato.
  • Integração e Pós-Venda Inicial
    • Passage de Bastão: Transicionar o cliente de forma suave para a equipe clínica (Enfermeiro Coordenador), garantindo que todas as informações logísticas e financeiras sejam repassadas.
    • Feedback ao Marketing: Fornecer feedback constante à equipe de Marketing sobre a qualidade dos leads e as objeções mais comuns.

Qualificações Essenciais

  • Conhecimento de Vendas Digitais: Experiência comprovada em vendas B2C ou B2B de alto valor por meio de canais digitais (e-mail, telefone, videoconferência).
  • Proficiência em CRM: Domínio do uso de plataformas CRM (como Pipedrive ou HubSpot) para o gerenciamento de funil, de atividades e de relatórios.
  • Noções Básicas de Saúde: Capacidade de compreender termos clínicos básicos (ex: Gastrostomia, AVC, Lesão por Pressão) para qualificar o lead corretamente.
  • Comunicação Escrita e Verbal: Excelente habilidade de comunicação formal e persuasiva.

Diferenciais e Soft Skills

  • Empatia e Sensibilidade: Lidar com estresse, culpa e ansiedade do familiar, oferecendo suporte emocional antes da venda.
  • Inteligência Emocional (Resiliência): Receber “não” de clientes sob pressão emocional ou orçamentária, mantendo a calma e a ética.
  • Foco na Solução, não apenas no Produto: Ir além do script de vendas, focando em como o Home Care resolverá o problema central da família (segurança, descanso, qualidade de vida do paciente).
  • Organização Autônoma: Gerenciar vários leads em diferentes estágios do funil, priorizando atendimento de urgências clínicas e mantendo prazos de propostas.
  • Bonificação à metas: O salário competitivo com bonificação ao atingir metas palpáveis.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

title: Fonoaudiólogo - UCI NEONATAL
description:
Job description

Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar avaliação fonoaudiológica especializada dos recém-nascidos internados na UTI Neonatal, considerando condições clínicas, neurológicas e respiratórias;
  • Avaliar e acompanhar a sucção não nutritiva e nutritiva, a coordenação sucção–deglutição–respiração e a prontidão para alimentação oral;
  • Atuar na prevenção, diagnóstico e manejo de alterações da deglutição, visando à segurança alimentar do recém-nascido;
  • Participar da definição de estratégias de alimentação, incluindo via oral, enteral e transição alimentar, em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional;
  • Implementar intervenções fonoaudiológicas para estimulação oral e sensório-motora, respeitando a condição clínica e o desenvolvimento do neonato;
  • Monitorar sinais de risco para aspiração, desconforto respiratório e intolerância alimentar, comunicando prontamente à equipe assistencial;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com equipe médica, enfermagem, nutrição, fisioterapia e demais profissionais, participando de discussões clínicas e rounds assistenciais;
  • Orientar pais e familiares quanto aos cuidados relacionados à alimentação, sucção e desenvolvimento oral do recém-nascido, promovendo cuidado centrado na família;
  • Registrar avaliações, condutas, evolução fonoaudiológica e orientações em prontuário eletrônico, garantindo rastreabilidade e continuidade do cuidado;
  • Participar de auditorias internas, revisões de prontuário e ações de melhoria contínua dos processos assistenciais;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração, revisão e adesão a protocolos relacionados à alimentação, deglutição e cuidados fonoaudiológicos neonatais;
  • Atuar na capacitação da equipe assistencial quanto às boas práticas relacionadas à alimentação segura e estimulação oral do neonato.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Fonoaudiologia e registro no conselho ativo;
  • Especialização (concluída ou em andamento) em Neonatologia, Fonoaudiologia Hospitalar, Disfagia Neonatal ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em ambiente hospitalar, preferencialmente em UTI Neonatal ou unidades de cuidados neonatais.

Additional information

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Clube de vantagens do colaborador;
  • Clube da saúde para o colaborador.

title: Mecanico I
description:
Job description

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Veículos Comerciais

Somos a maior rede de distribuição de veículos comerciais e peças genuínas Mercedes-Benz do país, com 27 pontos de venda presentes em 13 estados, tendoem seu portfólio caminhões, ônibus e utilitários.

Representamos também a marca de pneus Michelin, referência mundial em seu ramo, o que também nos torna a maior distribuidora de pneus de carga da América Latina.

Main responsibilities

Gestor, assista o vídeo abaixo para apoio na descrição de atividades desse cargo. Nesse vídeo você irá encontrar informações importantes para esse processo.

Abertura de Vaga - Mapeamento de perfil.mp4 (sharepoint.com)

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar manutenções corretivas e preventivas em caminhões, ônibus e veículos utilitários, utilizando as ferramentas e os equipamentos necessários, para que todo o processo seja realizado de acordo com o manual técnico.
  • Efetuar pequenos reparos de mecânica, verificando a pressão de galeria, pressão de intercooler, trocas de correias e trocas de óleo, para que as especificações do fabricante sejam cumpridas.
  • Conhecer técnicas de reparação, utilizando a documentação necessária e manuais, para realizar reparos, ajustes e regulagens.
  • Prezar pelo funcionamento e bom estado dos equipamentos, peças desmontadas e trocadas, averiguando e testando após o término da intervenção, a fim de cumprir as normas técnicas de segurança e procedimentos.
  • Zelar pelas ferramentas e equipamentos, mantendo a limpeza e a organização, a fim de conservar os instrumentos e o box de trabalho.
  • Analisar as ordens de serviços a serem executados, separando as ferramentas necessárias para as manutenções, a fim de diagnosticar e reparar falhas nos equipamentos.

Requirements and skills

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio Completo.

Descrição do Cargo

Além disso, atuará com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente Informatica PowerCenter ou soluções similares, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, assegurando que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, performance e reutilização.

  • Implementar e manter processos de ETL, preferencialmente utilizando Informatica PowerCenter ou ETL similar, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e governança dos dados migrados.
  • Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.
  • Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados em GCP.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Conhecimento avançado em BigQuery e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Proficiência em SQL para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação.
  • Experiência com ETL, preferencialmente Informatica PowerCenter ou ferramentas similares (Talend, DataStage, etc.).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com DBT para modelagem de dados, versionamento e boas práticas de engenharia analítica.
  • Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados.
